slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: The Data Landscapers 54-country review, an AI-assisted compilation by its own header, scores Sierra Leone's rural police stations 1 and says they record criminal cases and complaints entirely on paper, in occurrence books, dockets and manual files kept in locked cabinets; it gives no date, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: occurrence books, dockets and manual files

facts.fact: The same review's Sierra Leone police row says it found no evidence of a digital case management system deployed at rural stations; it gives no date, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: occurrence books, dockets and manual files

facts.fact: The same review says the Sierra Leone Police's 2025-2029 Strategic Development Plan plans an e-Case Management System, with a baseline survey in 2025 and implementation from 2026; the plan's own start year is used.

systems.system: occurrence books, dockets and manual files

systems.tiers: planned: baseline survey 2025, implementation 2026 onward; not deployed at rural stations
digitised 2025; the review calls it urban or regional, or not case related
